title: MERN Stack
tagline: Build full-stack web applications with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js.
description: Go from writing your first React component to shipping a complete, deployed web application. This program covers the full MERN stack end to end — frontend UI, backend APIs, databases, and deployment — through the same patterns used in real product teams.
outcomes: Build and deploy full-stack web applications end to end
Design and secure REST APIs with Node.js and Express
Build dynamic, responsive UIs with React
Model, query, and manage data with MongoDB

topics: Build and deploy a full-stack MERN application

projects: Build a full-stack e-commerce or booking app with authentication
Deploy a MERN application to a live cloud host

faqs.q: Do I need prior coding experience?
faqs.a: Basic familiarity with programming logic helps, but we cover JavaScript fundamentals from the start.

faqs.q: Will I have a project to show employers afterward?
faqs.a: Yes — the capstone is a full deployed application you can add directly to your portfolio and GitHub.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Live and Self-Paced?
faqs.a: Live batches include instructor-led sessions, real-time doubt clearing, and mentorship. Self-Paced gives you the recorded content on your own schedule. Both include the same projects and certificate.
